newsitem.title: GERMANY: Global One wins Volvo data contract.
newsitem.headline: Global One wins Volvo data contract.

text.p: Global One, the joint venture of Deutsche Telekom, France Telecom and Sprint Corp., said Tuesday it won a contract to carry global data communications for AB Volvo of Sweden.
The contract was awarded by a Volvo subsidiary to supply data communication services to the corporation's internal communications network.
"The major condition for being asked was our global presence," Lars-Erik Larsson, area manager for Global One in Gothenburg, Sweden, said in a statement.

Global One is an international joint venture to supply global communications services to multinational corporations. Its main rivals are the Concert venture of British Telecom Plc and MCI Communications Corp. of the United States and the World Partners alliance lead by AT&T Corp.
Global One will connect Volvo communications hubs in Sweden, Belgium, Singapore, Britain and the United States.
Daily communications traffic on the network will range from electronic mail to data transmission services, local area network interconnection and managed bandwidth services.
